title: Students Allegedly Used AI to Create and Share Fake Nude Images of Classmates in Puente Alto, Chile
summary: Students at Colegio Alicante del Sol, a school in Puente Alto, Chile, allegedly used AI tools to turn female classmates' Instagram photos into fake nude images and circulated them among other students. Families reported panic attacks among affected girls. The school suspended implicated students, and Chile's education oversight authority opened an investigation into its response.
